profile.reading: Per East Kentucky Network own site, this Ivel, Kentucky facility sits at 271 Technology Trail and totals 16,700 square feet, described as featuring redundant power sources, environmental controls, and transport capacity to hub locations in Chicago and Ashburn, with an Atlanta hub described as forthcoming. No power capacity in MW is published on this page.
